issues.title: Export totals show the wrong day in every line item since 4.12
issues.ask: Correct the day shown for every line item in the export, so reconciliation aligns and finance no longer has to re-run exports by hand each morning.
issues.summary: Since release 4.12 the client's exported bill assigns the wrong date to every line item, causing an off-by-one reconciliation and daily manual re-exports by finance.
